title: Article 390 — Moneys received or raised or expenditure incurred between commencement and first Consolidated Fund arrangements (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 390 was a transitional financial provision for moneys and expenditure between commencement of the Constitution and the establishment of the Consolidated Fund arrangements. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent; not living law.
content.glance: Art 390 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Transitional finance — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 390?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
